document-architecture.deliverable: Reviewed source analysis, target architecture, ADRs, AI manifest, and canonical dependency graph.
acceptance: Reference claims are traceable to the pinned SQLite source.
The graph is acyclic and the canonical order is valid.
All architecture decisions are reviewed before implementation.

bootstrap-build.deliverable: C++23 CMake, Ninja, CTest, GoogleTest, formatting, static analysis, presets, and graph automation.
acceptance: Configure, build, and unit-test smoke paths work on macOS and Linux.
Zero selected tests is a failure.
Graph validation and ready-node selection are automated.

implement-bytes.deliverable: Byte views, owned byte buffers, checked slicing, and strong byte-count types.
acceptance: Focused tests cover empty, boundary, overlap, and out-of-range behavior.

implement-error-result.deliverable: Typed error categories, SQLite code mapping, and Result aliases.
acceptance: Tests prove value/error propagation and no success-shaped fallback.

implement-instrumentation.deliverable: Optional standard-library-only counters and scoped collection with zero ordinary-build cost.
acceptance: Tests prove disabled hooks compile out and scoped counters cannot leak across operations.

implement-coding.deliverable: Endian coding, SQLite varints, checked arithmetic, and checksums needed by early formats.
acceptance: Independent SQLite golden vectors cover valid, boundary, overlong, and truncated inputs.

implement-text.deliverable: UTF-8 views, source spans, SQLite lexical character classes, and case helpers.
acceptance: Tests cover ASCII, UTF-8 boundaries, invalid sequences where relevant, and source offsets.

implement-sql-value.deliverable: NULL, integer, real, text, blob, affinity, numeric conversion, and comparison primitives.
acceptance: Differential value tests match SQLite conversion and NULL behavior for the supported surface.

implement-collation.deliverable: BINARY, NOCASE, RTRIM, and custom collation contracts.
acceptance: Ordering and equality vectors match pinned SQLite.

implement-function-registry.deliverable: Function signatures, scalar invocation, determinism flags, and initial core functions.
acceptance: Tests cover arity, NULL propagation, errors, and deterministic metadata.

implement-record-codec.deliverable: SQLite record headers, serial types, field decoding, encoding, and index-key comparison.
acceptance: Bidirectional and independent SQLite golden vectors cover malformed and boundary records.

implement-vfs-contracts.deliverable: File, locking, shared-memory, clock, randomness, and durability interfaces.
acceptance: Contract tests use deterministic fake files and expose every failure explicitly.

implement-posix-vfs.deliverable: Linux/macOS POSIX VFS with positioned I/O, sync, truncation, deletion, and locking.
acceptance: Filesystem tests cover short I/O, sync ordering, lock conflicts, and cleanup.

implement-page-cache.deliverable: Typed page frames, pin handles, dirty state, replacement, and memory-pressure contracts.
acceptance: Tests cover pinning, eviction, dirty-page exclusion, capacity, and deterministic writeback requests.

implement-read-pager.deliverable: Read-only page service, database-header validation, read transactions, and cache invalidation.
acceptance: SQLite-created databases of supported page sizes are read consistently and corrupt headers fail explicitly.

implement-btree-page.deliverable: Pure B-tree page, cell, overflow, freelist, and pointer-map decoders.
acceptance: Golden and fuzz tests cover every page kind, malformed offset, overflow, and fragmentation boundary.

implement-btree-read.deliverable: Read-only table and index cursors with seek, first, last, next, previous, and payload access.
acceptance: Traversal and seek results match SQLite across generated rowid and index databases.

implement-storage-diagnostics.deliverable: Read-only database-header, page, B-tree, record, freelist, and corruption inspection command.
acceptance: Diagnostics use production decoders, never mutate the database, and produce stable machine-readable output for golden databases.

implement-lexer.deliverable: SQLite-compatible tokenization with precise spans and diagnostics.
acceptance: Token streams match pinned SQLite for the supported grammar corpus and malformed input.

implement-ast.deliverable: Immutable syntax nodes that preserve literal syntax and contain no runtime value, catalog, cursor, register, or bytecode state.
acceptance: Ownership and source-span tests prove safe construction and destruction of deep trees.

implement-parser.deliverable: Pure parser for the initial SQL subset with deterministic diagnostics.
acceptance: Positive and negative parser corpora cover precedence, limits, malformed SQL, and full input consumption.

implement-catalog-model.deliverable: Immutable schemas, tables, columns, indexes, root-page IDs, and statistics metadata.
acceptance: Tests cover identity, lookup, versioning, and schema snapshot ownership.

implement-catalog-loader.deliverable: Read `sqlite_schema`, parse stored DDL, build catalog snapshots, and detect schema changes.
acceptance: Catalogs from SQLite-created databases match expected objects and corrupt schema fails explicitly.

implement-bytecode.deliverable: Typed opcodes, operands, registers, cursors, labels, immutable programs, and verifier.
acceptance: Verifier tests reject invalid register, cursor, jump, and resource lifetimes.

implement-read-vm.deliverable: Hand-authored read programs, registers, B-tree cursors, comparisons, projection, and row suspension.
acceptance: VM tests execute hand-built programs and match expected rows, errors, and reset behavior.

implement-binder.deliverable: Name, column, function, affinity, and collation resolution into bound identifiers.
acceptance: Differential tests cover ambiguity, missing names, aliases, and supported coercion rules.

implement-logical-plan.deliverable: Logical scans, filters, projections, limits, and statement plans.
acceptance: Plan tests assert semantics without depending on bytecode addresses.

implement-basic-optimizer.deliverable: Deterministic table-scan and rowid access selection with explicit cost data.
acceptance: Plan-choice tests cover full scans, rowid equality, impossible predicates, and stable explain output.

implement-read-lowering.deliverable: Physical read plans lowered into verified bytecode.
acceptance: End-to-end compiler tests compare verified programs and execution results.

implement-read-session-api.deliverable: RAII database and prepared-statement API for open, prepare, bind, step, reset, and finalize.
acceptance: Read-only SQL results and errors match pinned SQLite for the supported matrix.

build-read-compatibility-harness.deliverable: Golden databases, differential SQL traces, model tests, fuzz targets, and offline diagnostics.
acceptance: SQLite-write/Modern-read compatibility runs reproducibly with pinned provenance.

build-read-performance-baseline.deliverable: Matched SQLite read benchmark, strict report schema, provenance, counters, and profiling workflow.
acceptance: Every benchmark verifies correctness and rejects empty, malformed, skipped, or non-finite results.

implement-journal-contracts.deliverable: Journal backend, page-image, savepoint, recovery, and commit-order contracts.
acceptance: Fake-backend tests prove state transitions and ordering without real storage.

implement-rollback-journal.deliverable: SQLite-compatible rollback-journal DELETE mode and hot-journal recovery.
acceptance: Golden journals and deterministic torn-write/power-loss cases recover to SQLite-equivalent states.

implement-write-pager.deliverable: Writable pages, pager state machine, commit, rollback, savepoints, and spill ordering.
acceptance: Every mutating I/O boundary has a deterministic failure and recovery test.

implement-btree-write.deliverable: Insert, delete, balancing, page allocation, overflow mutation, root creation, and clear/drop.
acceptance: SQLite reads generated files, integrity_check passes, and model operations match a reference map.

implement-transaction-coordinator.deliverable: Single-database implicit/explicit transactions, statement rollback, and savepoints.
acceptance: State-machine and crash tests prove atomic visibility and rollback behavior.

implement-dml-ddl.deliverable: Basic CREATE TABLE, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and catalog mutation lowering.
acceptance: Differential SQL traces match rows, types, errors, changes, and database contents.

build-writable-mvp-harness.deliverable: Bidirectional format, crash, model, sanitizer, fuzz, and integrity-check harness for the writable MVP.
acceptance: Modern-write/SQLite-read and SQLite-write/Modern-read matrices pass reproducibly.

establish-write-performance-baseline.deliverable: Matched insert, update, delete, commit, rollback, allocation, I/O, and work-count baselines.
acceptance: Reports separate default and matched durability configurations and verify final contents.

implement-index-planning.deliverable: Index creation, index scans, covering scans, selectivity estimates, and ANALYZE/statistics support.
acceptance: Plan and result tests match SQLite for supported index cases and retain scan fallbacks.

implement-advanced-sql.deliverable: Joins, sorting, aggregates, subqueries, CTEs, views, constraints, triggers, and remaining core SQL in reviewed slices.
acceptance: Each feature slice adds its own differential, malformed, and performance tests.

implement-concurrency-locking.deliverable: Multi-connection rollback-mode locking, busy handling, interruption, and deadlock-aware contracts.
acceptance: Deterministic multi-process tests cover legal lock transitions, busy outcomes, and crash release.

implement-wal.deliverable: WAL frames, checksums, wal-index, snapshots, read marks, checkpoints, and recovery.
acceptance: Bidirectional WAL interoperability, lock-state, checkpoint, snapshot, and crash matrices pass.

implement-c-api-compatibility.deliverable: Reviewed SQLite-compatible C API subset over the native C++ session layer.
acceptance: API ownership, callback, error-code, reentrancy, and ABI tests cover the declared compatibility matrix.

implement-extensions.deliverable: Virtual tables and selected extensions through explicit extension contracts.
acceptance: Each extension is separately scoped, tested, benchmarked, and documented.

harden-engine.deliverable: Integrated compatibility, crash, sanitizer, fuzz, compiler, concurrency, and performance gates.
acceptance: The complete declared compatibility matrix passes with reproducible artifacts and no unresolved review finding.
